strategy.title: No executable plan yet: run a zero-cost 5-day paid-offer test of one-time Google Business Profile optimisation for local small businesses
strategy.why: None of the three zero-capital routes has a buyer shown paying the offered price or a measured close rate. The best-supported one is a one-time Google Business Profile optimisation sold directly to local businesses at $250 (below WebFX's published $500-$5,000 range for one-time local SEO projects), paid by Zelle so cash is usable the same day; but 6 cold closes in 14 days by an owner with no track record is unmeasured. Upwork needs paid Connects beyond the 10 free per month and new freelancers report 50-100 proposals before a first hire, and fixed-price funds clear only after client review plus a 5-day hold; Prolific pays about $8-12 per hour, so $1,500 would need ~125 study-hours of a study supply that is not published. A new PayPal seller can see funds held up to 21 days and a new Stripe account's first payout is 7-14 days after the first payment, so card/PayPal collection is not a safe settlement path inside 14 days.

alternatives.title: Upwork fixed-price AI-assisted writing and listing jobs
alternatives.why: Zero capital buys only the 10 free Connects a month (1-3 proposals) while about 11 proposals per hire are needed market-wide and new profiles report far more; settlement is client review (up to 14 days) plus a 5-day security hold.

alternatives.title: Prolific paid study participation
alternatives.why: Minimum $8/hour, recommended $12/hour; $1,500 needs ~125 hours of studies in 14 days and per-participant study availability is not published.

reviews.reasons: Every earlier finding is answered. Stance is now CONDITIONAL, with validation.decides CURRENT_DEMAND, OFFER_AND_PRICE, CONVERSION and FULFILMENT, and these are exactly the unknowns a live test measures. Fulfilment is proved first: a free pilot on day 1 (stop if over 4 owner hours or not accepted) comes before any paid offer on day 2, so no buyer's order is taken before delivery is shown possible. Price $250 is honestly ASSUMED, WebFX is no longer cited as price support, and card_price matchesBuyer is false. Recomputed: $0 spend and $0 exposure, inside the $0 cap. 6 x $250 = $1,500. The threshold is 3 paid of 60 (5%); over 240 contacts that implies about 12 paid, twice the 6 needed, so passing at threshold carries the target with margin. Zelle on delivery is typically available in minutes, up to 3 business days, and the ledger's receipts on days 6-11 settle by day 14. Brain's trace agrees: collected $1,500 in window, $0 spent. Excluding Upwork (a Connects purchase may be required; review plus 5-day hold) and Prolific (~125 h at $12/h) is correct.
findings: Settlement is tight at the end: orders 5-6 are received on day 11, and with Zelle's 'up to 3 business days' and a weekend that can fall past day 14. Close the last orders by about day 9-10, or count only the minute-settled Zelle payments toward the day-14 proof.
Owner hours total 59 in 14 days (about 30 h/week). The contract states no ceiling, so this is not a breach, but it is the plan's heaviest demand and the owner should see it before starting.
Zelle used to take payment from businesses: some banks restrict personal Zelle for commercial receipts. The owner should confirm that their bank allows it, or use a small-business Zelle profile.
The card's links stay unestablished until the test: this is a startable test, not an executable plan, which the CONDITIONAL stance correctly says.

strategy.title: Sell one-time $250 Google Business Profile optimisations to local businesses, paid by Zelle, after a free fulfilment pilot and gated by a 60-contact test
strategy.why: It is the only zero-capital route that is startable and can settle inside 14 days: no spend is needed, the owner fulfils it, and Zelle between enrolled accounts is typically available in minutes (up to 3 business days for select payments), avoiding the new-account PayPal (up to 21-day) and Stripe (first payout 7-14 days) holds. Whether local businesses pay $250 to this owner, and at what close rate, is unknown - only the live test measures it; the price is an assumption, not evidence. Upwork may require a Connects purchase before any proposal (forbidden: no spend) and Prolific needs ~125 study-hours.
